raw_tokens.value: This iron blacksmith's hammer bears designs of Torag's holy symbol; it is not designed for combat, but the bearer can use it as a Medium light hammer. Once per day, the bearer can strike the hammer hard against a weapon to target that weapon with Magic Weapon. The owner gains a +2 competence bonus on all smithing (armorsmithing, blacksmithing, weaponsmithing, and so on) skill checks made when crafting with the forgehammer. If Torag is the owner's patron: once per day the owner can strike the hammer against another character's armor or shield to cast Shield Other on that character; if the owner can craft magic weapons or armor and uses the forgehammer during the crafting, the total time to craft the item is decreased by 25%% (minimum 1 day). This does not reduce the cost to create the item. A particular forgehammer can aid in only one item's crafting at a time.
